concerns.text: T103 writes deviation_contexts.csv with columns `smiles,bit_index,matched_substructure,interaction_strength` while claiming it conforms to `contracts/interaction_context.schema.yaml`, whose required fields are `bit_i, bit_j, interaction_strength, substructure_desc, context_type`. The task's own verification (exact header) contradicts its claimed contract conformance, so an implementer cannot satisfy both. Pick one column set and align the schema reference.

T102 allows the persisted `.npy` to be either shape `(n_test, n_bits, n_bits)` or `(n_bits, n_bits)` ('state which in the script'), but T103 ranks 'top-K MACCS bits by mean |interaction value|' from that file without specifying how to aggregate over the per-molecule axis if the tensor form is chosen. Specify the aggregation (e.g., mean over axis 0) or mandate the mean-aggregated matrix so T103 is deterministic.

T106's inventory asserts existence of `model_comparison.png`, `interaction_zone_map.md`, `physical_vs_statistical_analysis.md`, and `validation_audit.md`, none of which is produced by T101–T105; they rest only on the prose 'Verified' preamble. If any was among the rejected/never-materialized outputs, the integration test fails with no task to fix it. Add a one-line pointer to the producing verified task/command for each, or note the fallback.
